proposal.title: Independent cross-pair numerical candidate-selection replication
proposal.question: Across previously untested numerical candidate pairs, do L1H0 and L4H0 exhibit context-stable causal pair/token directions that generalize more reliably than arithmetic correctness?

design.replication_target: Test whether L1H0 and L4H0 show context-stable causal candidate-pair directions on new numerical candidate pairs more reliably than they track arithmetic correctness.
design.exclusion_reason: L3H3 is the primary mechanistic target of HYP-V03-004 and should receive a separate dedicated replication experiment.

positive_control.purpose: Verify that the known mature v0.3 L1H0-four and L4H0-five causal directions remain detectable in the same run.

design.canonical_margin: logit(lower discriminative token) - logit(upper discriminative token)

direction_interpretation.negative_delta: intact head supports LOWER relative to UPPER
direction_interpretation.positive_delta: intact head supports UPPER relative to LOWER

correctness_effect.positive: intact head supports the semantically correct answer
correctness_effect.negative: intact head suppresses the semantically correct answer

replication_metrics_to_freeze_in_plan.pair_direction_stability: Within each head × pair cell, measure whether at least 3/4 raw ablation deltas share the same sign.
replication_metrics_to_freeze_in_plan.pair_generalization: For each primary head, count how many of the four new pairs pass pair-direction stability.
replication_metrics_to_freeze_in_plan.correctness_tracking: For each primary head, count positive correctness effects across the 16 primary probes.
replication_metrics_to_freeze_in_plan.weak_control: L4H1 mean absolute ablation delta should remain below each primary head.

candidate_thresholds_for_plan_freeze.hypothesis_replication_intent: Both primary heads should show pair-direction stability across new pairs without both meeting the strong arithmetic-correctness tracking criterion.

competing_explanations.label: A
competing_explanations.name: candidate_pair_or_token_bias
competing_explanations.prediction: Raw ablation-delta direction is stable within candidate pairs even when which candidate is arithmetically correct changes.

competing_explanations.label: B
competing_explanations.name: arithmetic_correctness_circuit
competing_explanations.prediction: Ablation-delta direction switches with correctness so correctness effects remain consistently positive or negative across pairs.

competing_explanations.label: C
competing_explanations.name: candidate_order_artifact
competing_explanations.prediction: Effects primarily follow lower/upper orientation rather than pair identity.

competing_explanations.label: D
competing_explanations.name: intervention_or_measurement_artifact
competing_explanations.prediction: Positive control fails or weak-control effects become comparable to primary heads.

scientific_constraints: Primary replication pairs must not reuse EXP-0006 primary pair identities P23/P34/P45/P56.
Lower-correct and upper-correct conditions must be balanced within every primary pair.
Word-form and symbol-form arithmetic contexts must both be represented within every primary pair.
P45 may be reused only as an explicit positive control and must be excluded from primary replication metrics.
L1H0 and L4H0 are primary heads; L4H1 is a weak control.
No persistent model parameter modification is permitted.
Exact tokenization and first discriminative-token identity must be verified before the plan can be frozen.
